steps.content: You and Uni are at the function organized by the councilor. Violin music in the background, whiffs of perfume in the air, drinks in pretentious hands... Decadence is the word that pops into your head as you take in the surroundings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Legendary Cosmetic Surgeon, Scarless and Painless, No Hospital Stay Necessary! Beauty is only one call away. For more information..."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What a load of nonsense.

There is a legion of sketchy websites in DisCity's cyberspace. They mix fact with fiction. But if you're discerning enough, they can be a good source of information, a window to the dark side of the city.
The moment you saw the title Legendary Cosmetic Surgeon, you thought of Uni, the eccentric woman who is the very reason why you're at this boring function.

Uni's interrogation was brought to an abrupt end by the councilor's interference, before you could establish if there is a connection between Uni and the missing persons. And you're still trying to figure out why Uni attacked you.
You're facing a messy situation and having trouble untangling it.
You're now standing next to the culprit who has caused all this confusion.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Check them out, looking all fancy.
You and Uni are far away from the center of activity, in a corner where the dessert table stands. Two neat rows of plates are all empty, obviously thanks to the Sinner standing at your side.
You turn off the terminal and pocket it. Uni has just finished up the last bit of the dessert in her hand.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: The desserts, like the guests, look good on the outside but have no taste whatsoever.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You would sound more convincing if you weren't gulping them down as if they're going out of style.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You don't believe me? One o'clock. Do you know how they describe him? They call him "an Adonis as beautiful as a picture."
You see a handsome young man talking to a kind-looking old lady at the cold food table.
She taps on the screen of her terminal and calls up a photo of a plain-looking man with heavy features.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: This is what he used to look like.
There is a world of difference in appearance between the man on the screen and the handsome young man, though you can see traces that point to the two being the same person.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Do you know what he says when asked why he looks so different from before?
Uni taps her jaw with her index finger.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: He says, "I had my wisdom tooth pulled out."

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: And the old man and the man standing in that corner with a drink, do you know who they are?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, I'm not very familiar with the Eastside entertainment industry.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Ah, you're being modest. Quite a few of the MBCC Sinners are big players in show business.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: <size=30>Anyway, it's not just actors and actresses who need my services. Among my clientele are politicians who want to look more relatable, businessmen who want to look more professional, you name it. I'll never go out of business, as long as human beings stay superficial and greedy.</size>

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Both of their faces are my work. They had a ton of requests. Quite a headache, to be honest.
Uni gives a snort, picks up a cookie from a colorful pile on the table, and takes a bite. She frowns.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: What's this? It tastes like plastic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sugar-free macarons, I heard.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Sugar-free macarons? Ugh! Even worse than those diet drinks. These things look good. But they're all about the appearance, not the content.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Beautiful on the outside, rotten on the inside.
She crumbles the macaron in her hand.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: All they care about is what's on the outside, just like those who come to me for a new face. All they want is a shiny layer of beautiful skin for the world to see.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: What they want is what I give them. For a reasonable price, I can help them get rid of the things they don't like about their faces.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I do excellent jobs, and I do them fast. They couldn't be happier with my services.

options: They never suspected that you're a Sinner?

choices.text: They never suspected that you're a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: They wouldn't have cared even if they did.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Looks are everything in their world. A flawless face is the key to success.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Their desire to own a beautiful face turns them into risk-takers, and makes them willing to put aside their fear of Mania for a while.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: More than Mania, it's the prospect of being forgotten by this city that fills them with dread.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's pointless to try to drag one out of the mire of greed if they don't want to get out. It's like...
As you listen to Uni disparaging the guests, you think back to the recent interrogation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you see when you look into that mirror of yours?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: What a nonsensical question. It's a mirror. I see my reflection when I look in the mirror, just like everybody else.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's... me. Who else could it be?
Your conversation with Uni amid the din of the crowd is then interrupted by a booming voice.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Well, look who's here! It's our Dr. Genius, the star-maker of DisCity! Don't hide in the corner. You're the guest of honor. Let's go over there.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I'll pass. Too crowded.
The councilor takes no offense at Uni's refusal, laughing wholeheartedly.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: And this is?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm a friend of Dr. Uni's.
There is an amused expression on Uni's face. She opens her mouth to say something but catches herself.
The councilor takes a closer look at you. His expression changes as something dawns on him. He pats you on the shoulder knowingly.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: The arrangement regarding our cuts still stands. Now, let's enjoy ourselves and drink to our hearts' content.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have you to thank for that.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: It's Uni, the legendary doctor, that you should thank. Look around. All of these guests are big players in DisCity. But most of them wouldn't have had a chance to be here if it weren't for Uni.
The councilor swings his hand, almost spilling his drink. Then he remarks on the people who Uni has just derided, only from a different angle.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: These are not one-time clients. If we can maintain good relationships with them, we'll be able to make...
The tipsy man mimes a number with his fingers.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: At least this much every year.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Hahaha... Don't get stressed out just yet. Tonight is all about making friends. One can't get around in this world without friends, right?
"We're friends. Introduce cash cows to me in the future," his smiley face seems to say.
You then notice a beautiful young woman behind the councilor. She's looking at Uni with curiosity and admiration.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is...?

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Oh, I almost forgot. This is one of our new recruits. She's been with us for a while now, but her career still hasn't really taken off. So I took her along to meet some friends of mine.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: Another superstar in the making, I'm sure, once Uni gets a hand in the project.
You notice that the young woman's eyes are filled with longing as she listens to the councilor's speech.
You turn your head, hoping to get Uni involved in the conversation, only to find that she has retreated to a quieter corner, having taken the remaining snacks on the table with her.
You feel like you're stuck between a rock and a hard place. On your left is the councilor, who is babbling away about nothing in particular; on your right is Uni, who is silently enjoying her snacks.

steps.speaker: Councilor
steps.content: No time like the present. Let's get the surgery done tonight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Huh?
A chance to untangle the mess has presented itself.
Cosmetic surgeon, Clinic, Cosmetic surgery, Missing persons.
You need a lead to untangle the mess, and a step-by-step plan to get to the truth.
After the function, the councilor left for another social engagement. Before he left, he entrusted the young woman to you and Uni. The three of you are heading for Uni's clinic.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You're not gonna stop me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to see it for myself, instead of waiting around and doing nothing.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Aren't you worried that I might do something unscrupulous during the surgery?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm confident that I can stop you before you do anything fishy.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Dr. Uni, which parts of my face do you think need changing? The shape of my lips is all right, but I don't like my nose very much.
The young woman speaks as if she is deciding what desserts she should pick for her tea party.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: What do you think, sir? You're a director, right?
steps.female_content: What do you think, miss? You're a director, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Director? Me?

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Well, you're Dr. Uni's friend, and the councilor treated you with great respect at the function. So I figure you must be a director who has worked with the two of them.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: So what do you think? Does this face suit me?
You try to picture the face she wants, a face that is an amalgam of features taken from different persons. It looks stiff, unnatural, and even slightly eerie.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think you're beautiful. You don't need surgery.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Well, being beautiful is not enough. My face has gone out of fashion. I won't make it in show business with my current face.
She pauses for a moment, then resumes in a small voice.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I have an audition tomorrow. The movie is likely to be nominated for next year's DisCars. That's why the councilor insisted I have the surgery today.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I did some research and found out the type of face this director likes in his actresses. If I have my face changed accordingly, I'll get the role and become more popular than those looking down their noses at me.

options: I like the way you look now better.

choices.text: I like the way you look now better.

steps.content: Your remark gives her pause. Then without warning, she bursts out laughing. And that marks the end of your conversation with her.
The car pulls up before the clinic. It's time to execute your plan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uni, I just got a message from Nightingale asking for photos of your operating room. It's urgent. Could you go in first and take some photos?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Me? Taking photos? You MBCC guys are useless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not useless, just a minor slip. I gotta give Nightingale a call. You go in first.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Fine... I'll let you know when I've got the photos.
Suspecting nothing, Uni walks toward the clinic while murmuring complaints.
You take out your terminal, and take a look at the screen, then at the young woman. You let out an audible sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: (Sighs) What a shame.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just got a call from a director friend. She's planning a new movie. She said she's looking for a female lead who is beautiful but doesn't quite conform to today's beauty standards. She asked me to keep an eye out for suitable candidates.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think you have just the right face. But you won't have it anymore after the surgery. That's why I said it's a shame.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: What? Who are you talking about? A famous director recently wanting actress... Ah! You're not talking about...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, I'm talking about her. You know how well-received her work is. I bet this new movie of hers is gonna win her multiple DisCars next year. It's a shame that you're not available to play a role in it.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Available, I'm available!

You gave the elated young woman a number and a address of the "famous director". She, after giving you her business card and insisting you call her up if another acting opportunity comes up, got out of the car, waved down a cab, and left.
As you look at the receding car, you can't help but heave a sigh of relief. You don't want to drag anyone into whatever is going to happen in Uni's clinic.
Now it's time to execute the second step of your plan: investigate the clinic.
The clinic is spotless. There's no surgical instrument or operating table in sight. You see innumerable mirrors on the walls, each reflecting the room hundreds of times over.
All of the mirrors, you discover when you come closer, are cracked.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uni...
You call out Uni's name, before going on to explore this clinic, feeling slightly uneasy.
No response.
In the silence, only the hum of an exhaust fan can be heard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where are you, Uni?
Still no response.
You sense through the shackles that there's a Sinner in the vicinity. You decide to explore the room further before she comes back.
You approach the dark-colored curtains.
When you draw back the curtains, you're greeted by a pair of eyes.
A familiar pair of eyes, one that you've seen thousands of times in the mirror.
They startle you, but you quickly calm down when you realize you're only looking at a portrait of a face on a wall.
Portrait may be the wrong word. The face on the wall is more like a jigsaw puzzle, made of pieces cut from different headshots. On the table under it are the incomplete headshots.
You pick them up. Your stomach churns as you go through them.
You recognize the faces. They belong to the missing celebrities. You had gone through the documents on these celebrities many times before you interrogated Uni.
The last photo is of you, only without the part where your eyes should've been, which has gone on the wall. It takes you aback.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's just my attempt to see how much superior you are to me, Honorable Leader versus Devious Trickster. Or you can think of it as a tentative attack.
She wasn't lying. Your suspicion has been confirmed; Uni is planning something. But what's her endgame?
You take a deep breath, put down the photos, and step back to better examine the face on the wall.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Could this be...

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Looks like you've discovered my secret.
You hear Uni's voice from behind, but before you can turn around, a pair of ice-cold hands grab you by the throat. And the air in the room trembles when she activates her power.
She tightens her grip. As you stare at the face on the wall, you grow certain that it's Uni's.

options: Uni, is that you on the wall?

choices.text: Uni, is that you on the wall?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: No. Try again. You're intelligent. You'll guess it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop this! Don't make the same mistake again.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Like I told you, greed can turn people into risk-takers.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You once asked me what I desire.
You feel her chilly breath on the nape of your neck. Riveted to the spot, you can only stare at the mirror before you. In it, you see only your reflection, not Uni's.
But you can sense that she is looking greedily into your eyes in the mirror as she traces a finger around their contours.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I desire your eyes.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: <size=31>The mirror image of the duckling sleeps on the other side of the lake, and the only way to bring it out is to get all the puzzle pieces together... Your eyes are the last piece of my puzzle. Once I complete it, I can bring my mirror image back.</size>

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I've desired them since the moment I spotted them at the DisCars ceremony. They look just like hers.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Our moment has finally come, Luna.

You sense a menacing energy coming from the other end of the shackles, so you activate the shackles, right at the same time when Uni activates her power. The mirror shatters. Everything goes black, and you slip into unconsciousness.
